findings.title: v82 restore-preflight rejections dead-end on a no-recovery boot screen (crafted/imported saves wedge the account)
findings.counterexample: No in-app producer writes a pick-less mortal v82 save: buildGameSave serializes the live player (sole-write via setMortalBasicSkill at bootstrap; deleted only inside the ritual commit for post-path players). The wedge requires a crafted/edited/imported save -- but the app's own export/import feature makes hand-editing the natural user response to 'incompatible' (a v81 export bumped 'version':81->82 is exactly this shape).
findings.expected: A save the boot path cannot consume should reach a recovery surface with export/delete, at minimum parity with 'incompatible'/'corrupted' (SaveIncompatibleScreen).
findings.actual: 'rejected' lands on the generic boot-error screen with no delete/export affordance; the wedged save loops every boot.
findings.rootCause: The restore-preflight failure class (restoreGameSession 'rejected') is routed to onError/boot.fail instead of saveIssue.report; v82 widened this class with the most plausible malformed-save shape (mortal missing pick).
